as_told.title: Ransone brings Gordon Cooper to Lab Nine

plain: In the 1970s the NASA astronaut Gordon Cooper is said to have visited, many times, the laboratory the researcher Andrija Puharich ran in Ossining, New York, and to have watched the strange work going on there. The researcher Greg Malatzi tells Michels that Cooper 'went to Ossining like many times.' According to Malatzi, Cooper wrote in his own book, Leap of Faith, about seeing experiments with a Faraday cage, a metal-screened room that blocks electrical signals. Cooper also wrote, Malatzi says, about seeing the children the lab called 'the space kids'. Another researcher in the same episode, who is not named, adds that a woman named Valerie Ransone brought Cooper there, and places the visits in the late 1970s. Both tellers are researchers passing on what they have read rather than witnesses. The story matters to them because it puts a famous astronaut inside a lab that, by their account, was trying to contact alien intelligences.
